name: QC Internal Dataset
query: SELECT DATE(e.occurred_at) AS 'occurredDate:Date:90', SUBSTRING(d.device_name, 4, 3) AS 'qc:Data:60', c.company_code AS 'companiesCode:Data:90', c.company_name AS 'companiesName:Data:140', c.name AS 'companyId:Data:120', f.factory_code AS 'factoriesCode:Data:90', f.factory_name AS 'factoriesName:Data:130', f.name AS 'factoryId:Data:120', COALESCE(lg.group_code, pl.line_code) AS 'lineGroupsCode:Data:90', COALESCE(lg.group_name, pl.line_name) AS 'lineGroupsName:Data:120', pl.line_code AS 'productionLinesCode:Data:90', pl.line_name AS 'productionLinesName:Data:120', pl.name AS 'productionLineId:Data:120', cu.customer_code AS 'customersCode:Data:90', cu.customer_name AS 'customersName:Data:130', p.product_code AS 'productsCode:Data:100', p.product_name AS 'productsName:Data:140', p.name AS 'productId:Data:120', qd.code AS 'qcDefectsCode:Data:90', qd.title AS 'qcDefectsName:Data:160', e.event_type AS 'eventType:Data:120', CAST(SUM(COALESCE(e.quantity_delta, 0)) AS SIGNED) AS 'quantitySummary:Int:100' FROM `tabQC Inspection Event` e INNER JOIN `tabFactory Device` d ON d.name = e.device LEFT JOIN `tabProduct` p ON p.name = e.product LEFT JOIN `tabCustomer` cu ON cu.name = p.customer LEFT JOIN `tabProduction Line` pl ON pl.name = e.line LEFT JOIN `tabFactory` f ON f.name = COALESCE(pl.factory, d.factory) LEFT JOIN `tabCompany` c ON c.name = COALESCE(f.company, pl.company, d.company) LEFT JOIN `tabLine Group Assignment` lga ON lga.line = pl.name AND lga.is_active = 1 LEFT JOIN `tabLine Group` lg ON lg.name = lga.line_group LEFT JOIN `tabQC Defect` qd ON qd.name = e.defect AND qd.record_type = 'Defect' WHERE e.occurred_at >= %(from_date)s AND e.occurred_at < DATE_ADD(%(to_date)s, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND (COALESCE(%(qc)s, '') = '' OR SUBSTRING(d.device_name, 4, 3) = %(qc)s) AND (COALESCE(%(company)s, '') = '' OR c.name = %(company)s) AND (COALESCE(%(factory)s, '') = '' OR f.name = %(factory)s) AND (COALESCE(%(line_group)s, '') = '' OR lg.name = %(line_group)s) AND (COALESCE(%(production_line)s, '') = '' OR pl.name = %(production_line)s) AND (COALESCE(%(customer)s, '') = '' OR cu.name = %(customer)s) AND (COALESCE(%(product)s, '') = '' OR p.name = %(product)s) GROUP BY DATE(e.occurred_at), SUBSTRING(d.device_name, 4, 3), c.company_code, c.company_name, c.name, f.factory_code, f.factory_name, f.name, COALESCE(lg.group_code, pl.line_code), COALESCE(lg.group_name, pl.line_name), pl.line_code, pl.line_name, pl.name, cu.customer_code, cu.customer_name, p.product_code, p.product_name, p.name, qd.code, qd.title, e.event_type ORDER BY DATE(e.occurred_at) DESC, c.company_name, pl.line_code, p.product_code, qd.code, qd.title, e.event_type
